theme: tRNA charging, modification and translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways cover tRNA aminoacylation, splicing and wobble modification, framed here as the tRNA-processing machinery that ensures accurate decoding and translational fidelity, alongside t6A modification, selenocysteine insertion and readthrough.

theme: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
core_role: The shared pathways describe lipase-driven remodeling and clearance of triglyceride-rich lipoproteins (chylomicrons and VLDL), framed as the upstream stage of a broader lipoprotein remodeling and clearance cascade that extends to LDL and HDL.

theme: Glycerolipid synthesis and glycerophospholipid turnover
core_role: The shared pathways cover phosphatidic acid, diacylglycerol and triacylglycerol synthesis, framed as the anabolic glycerolipid backbone pathway that is balanced by lysophospholipid hydrolysis and glycerophospholipid catabolism.

theme: Dendritic cell IL-12 driven Th1 immunity
core_role: The shared pathways describe dendritic cell IL-12 and cytokine production, MHC upregulation and IFN-gamma responses, framed as the antigen-presenting-cell activation that drives Th1 differentiation and type 1 immunity (e.g. against protozoa).

theme: Axon guidance by netrin and semaphorin signaling
core_role: The shared pathways cover axon extension and netrin and semaphorin-plexin guidance signaling, framed as the guidance-cue machinery of axon pathfinding, with Sema3A-mediated growth cone repulsion as the specific mechanism.

theme: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in branching organ morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and mesenchymal proliferation driving bud formation and branching in lung, salivary, lacrimal and mammary glands, framed as the generic organogenesis program also used in pancreatic, hepatic and renal epithelial development.

theme: Early neural plate patterning and neural crest specification
core_role: The shared pathways cover neural plate formation, neural plate border specification, dorsoventral axis and hindbrain/HOX boundary patterning, framed as the early embryonic patterning in which TFAP2 transcription factors specify neural crest and border fates.

theme: Gonadotropin control of gonadal follicle and germ cell development
core_role: The shared pathways describe FSH/LH secretion and response, ovarian follicle growth, oocyte maturation and Sertoli cell proliferation, framed as the gonadotropin-driven endocrine regulation of gametogenesis in both sexes.

theme: E2F-driven G1/S cell cycle transcription
core_role: The shared pathways cover E2F target transcription under RB-family/DREAM repression and cell cycle phase transitions, framed as the transcriptional program that licenses cell cycle entry and DNA replication.

theme: Regulation of lymphocyte development from hematopoietic progenitors
core_role: The shared pathways describe control of thymocyte proliferation, differentiation and survival in the thymus, framed as the T-lineage arm of lymphocyte development alongside B cell and progenitor differentiation control.

theme: Toll-like receptor signaling to NF-kappaB via TRAF6/TAK1
core_role: The shared pathways cover TRAF6-, IRAK1- and RIP1-mediated recruitment of TAK1 and IKK complexes and NF-kappaB activation, framed as the signal-transduction core of MyD88- and TRIF-dependent Toll-like receptor innate immune signaling.

theme: Epithelial hexose and urate transport by SLC transporters
core_role: The shared pathways describe SGLT/GLUT-mediated intestinal and renal transport of glucose, galactose and fructose and its genetic defects, framed as solute carrier epithelial transport that overlaps (via GLUT9/SLC2A9 and fructose) with renal urate handling.

theme: Sulfur amino acid catabolism and PLP-dependent cofactor metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover transsulfuration, cysteine catabolism, sulfide oxidation and cofactor (PLP, molybdenum cofactor) biosynthesis, framed as vitamin B6-dependent sulfur and amino acid catabolic metabolism.

theme: GPCR hormonal regulation of islet hormone secretion
core_role: The shared pathways describe glucagon, GLP-1, somatostatin, free fatty acid and acetylcholine receptor signaling controlling insulin and glucagon secretion, framed as GPCR/cAMP-mediated modulation of pancreatic islet secretion within a broader peptide-hormone receptor family.

theme: Lysosomal fusion with endosomes, autophagosomes and phagosomes
core_role: The shared pathways cover fusion of multivesicular bodies, late endosomes and autophagosomes with lysosomes, framed as the terminal membrane-fusion step that delivers cargo for lysosomal degradation, also used by phagosomes.

theme: cAMP/PKA second messenger signaling and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis, cyclic nucleotide responses and PKA activation, framed as the activating limb of cyclic nucleotide signaling that is balanced by phosphodiesterase-mediated cAMP degradation and negative feedback.

theme: Regulation of cellular cholesterol efflux and storage
core_role: The shared pathways cover LXR-regulated cholesterol import, efflux, storage and reverse cholesterol transport, framed as macrophage cholesterol homeostasis that determines foam cell formation and lipoprotein-mediated cholesterol flux.

theme: Death receptor extrinsic apoptosis and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe Fas and TRAIL death receptor signaling, procaspase-8 activation, c-FLIP inhibition and BID cleavage, framed as extrinsic apoptotic signaling as used notably in activation-induced T cell and thymocyte death.

theme: Dendritic spine and synapse maintenance
core_role: The shared pathways cover maintenance of neuron projections, dendritic spines and postsynaptic membrane organization, framed as synaptic structural stability that is compromised by amyloid-beta and coupled to impaired long-term potentiation.

theme: Male germ cell development and spermatogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe primordial germ cell migration, meiosis initiation, germ cell proliferation, Sertoli barrier formation and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly, framed as stages of spermatogenesis culminating in spermiogenic structures such as the manchette.

theme: Biomineralization of bone and teeth
core_role: The shared pathways cover positive and negative regulation of bone and enamel mineralization, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption, framed as the mineralized hard-tissue program of odontogenesis including dentin, enamel and cementum formation.

theme: Cytochrome P450 xenobiotic and toxin metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe CYP-mediated oxidative metabolism of xenobiotics, mycotoxins, alkaloids and aromatic amines, framed as phase I drug and toxin biotransformation that together with conjugation (acetylation) underlies detoxification such as paracetamol handling.

theme: Innate antimicrobial defense and host-pathogen interaction
core_role: The shared pathways cover neutrophil degranulation and killing, antimicrobial proteins, metal and heme sequestration and mucosal innate defense against bacteria and fungi, framed as the host effector side of an arms race in which pathogens such as Mtb subvert phagosome maturation, autophagy and apoptosis.

theme: Glutamate and aspartate transport at synapses
core_role: The shared pathways describe glutamate reuptake by excitatory amino acid transporters, vesicular glutamate loading and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycling with their disease defects, framed as solute carrier control of glutamatergic neurotransmitter homeostasis.

theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell cycle checkpoints
core_role: The shared pathways cover p53 phosphorylation and degradation control, p53-driven DNA repair and apoptosis, and G2/M checkpoint regulators, framed as the p53 signaling hub that integrates DNA damage into arrest, senescence or death.

theme: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signaling
core_role: The shared pathways describe NTRK3 and TRKA signaling through RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2/ARMS adaptors, ERK5 and CREB, framed as neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to MAPK cascades.

theme: Actin filament dynamics in cell shape control
core_role: The shared pathways cover actin crosslinking, severing, depolymerization, capping and Arp2/3 nucleation control, framed as the cytoskeletal remodeling machinery that sets cell shape and polarity under Rho GTPase and ephrin signaling.

theme: Hepatic glucose, fructose and glycerol metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe gluconeogenesis, glucokinase regulation, glucose-6-phosphatase/transporter function and fructose catabolism with their inherited disorders, framed as liver hexose phosphate metabolism feeding into glycerol and polyol metabolism.

theme: Selective autophagy of organelles
core_role: The shared pathways cover autophagosome assembly and selective autophagy of mitochondria, peroxisomes, ER and nucleus, framed as receptor-mediated organelle quality control regulated by ATG8 delipidation, UFMylation and nutrient sensing.

theme: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair
core_role: The shared pathways describe DSB sensing, ATM signaling, BRCA1/BRCA2 function and pathway choice between NHEJ, alt-NHEJ and homologous recombination, framed as the core of double-strand break repair extended by strand invasion, SDSA and crosslink repair.

theme: CNS myelination, glial responses and axon growth inhibition
core_role: The shared pathways cover oligodendrocyte proliferation, CNS myelin formation, reactive gliosis and myelin-associated RHOA-mediated axon growth inhibition, framed as the glial environment that restricts axon regeneration in the central nervous system.

theme: Golgi-endosome-lysosome protein sorting and retrograde trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways describe Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, lysosomal protein targeting and endosome-to-Golgi retrograde retrieval, framed as the post-Golgi membrane sorting system for lysosome biogenesis and the secretory pathway.

theme: Base excision repair and DNA damage reversal
core_role: The shared pathways cover glycosylase-initiated base excision repair, AP site processing and short/long patch gap filling with their defective variants, framed as the excision-based branch of repairing damaged bases alongside direct alkylation reversal.

theme: B cell and plasma cell transcriptional signatures
core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell, memory B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin gene modules and plasma cell differentiation, framed as the cellular identity signature of the B lineage within adaptive immune memory.

theme: Nephron and ureteric bud kidney development
core_role: The shared pathways cover intermediate mesoderm formation, metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and nephron patterning through renal vesicle and S-shaped body stages, framed as nephrogenesis coordinated with ureteric bud and collecting duct development.

theme: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and gas transport
core_role: The shared pathways describe Rh-glycoprotein-mediated ammonium and CO2 transmembrane transport and RHAG deficiency, framed as the transport function of Rh blood-group membrane proteins.

theme: Metanephric nephron induction and differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways cover intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud elongation, metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and nephron patterning, framed as the mesenchymal-to-epithelial program that turns nephron progenitors into tubules.

theme: Death receptor signaling to apoptosis and necroptosis
core_role: The shared pathways describe Fas and TRAIL death receptor signaling, BID activation and regulation of extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis, framed as the decision point between apoptotic and necrotic cell death.

theme: Heart chamber, septum and valve morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover ventricular and atrial myocardium formation, trabeculation, septation, endocardium and coronary vessel development, framed as cardiac morphogenesis that includes endocardial cushion EMT forming the heart valves.

theme: B cell activation and germinal center responses
core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell activation, proliferation, BCR signaling, ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation, Tfh differentiation and germinal center B cell differentiation, framed as T-dependent humoral immunity and its homeostatic control.

theme: Actin-driven membrane protrusion and cell migration
core_role: The shared pathways cover actin polymerization, severing, capping and Arp2/3 regulation driving lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis, framed as leading-edge cytoskeletal dynamics powering cell motility and chemotaxis.

theme: Hormonal and nuclear receptor control of lipid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe glucagon/PKA and AMPK signaling and LXR-regulated gene expression controlling triglyceride synthesis and fatty acid homeostasis, framed as the regulatory switch between lipogenesis and lipolysis in liver and adipose tissue.

theme: FGF receptor downstream signaling
core_role: The shared pathways cover PLC-gamma and PI3K cascades downstream of FGFR1-4, framed as the phosphoinositide-signaling outputs of FGF receptor activation alongside FRS2/SHC-RAS branches and ligand binding.

theme: TCA cycle and oxidative phosphorylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe the citric acid cycle, succinate dehydrogenase electron transfer and ATP synthesis, framed as mitochondrial oxidative energy metabolism fed by pyruvate and 2-oxoglutarate.

theme: Integrated stress response and unfolded protein response
core_role: The shared pathways cover eIF2 kinase-mediated translational control (PERK, HRI, GCN2) and UPR regulation, framed as stress-adaptive translation control whose unresolved ER stress leads to apoptosis, notably of pancreatic beta cells.

theme: Regulation of metanephric kidney development
core_role: The shared pathways describe intermediate mesoderm formation, nephron patterning and mesenchymal-to-epithelial differentiation in the metanephros, framed as nephrogenic differentiation whose extent is controlled by proliferation and kidney size regulation.

theme: Notch signaling and transcriptional output
core_role: The shared pathways cover Notch target gene transcription and its negative regulation, framed as the canonical NICD-driven transcriptional program that becomes constitutive in NOTCH1 PEST/HD mutants.

theme: Amino acid catabolism and organic acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe catabolism of phenylalanine, tyrosine, histidine, threonine, proline and glycine and related inborn errors, framed as mitochondrial and peroxisomal amino acid and organic acid degradation including glycine conjugation of aromatic acids.

theme: Antiviral innate immunity via RIG-I/MDA5 and type I interferon
core_role: The shared pathways cover RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, TRAF3/TRAF6 signaling to IRF3/IRF7 and NF-kB, type I IFN induction and ISG15 effectors with their viral evasion, framed as the cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing arm of antiviral defense converging on TBK1/IKKepsilon.

theme: B cell identity and germinal center activation
core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell, memory B cell and lymphocyte activation transcriptional modules, framed as the B-lineage signature engaged in T follicular helper-dependent germinal center responses.
